payload.summary: Boot/recovery chronology yields concrete causal fault oracles: recovery telemetry self-trigger loops, cancellation that misses live executor, fresh-install environment assumptions, packaged-binary bootstrap recursion, hidden interactive installer hangs, seed-vs-live-state boot distinction, topology drift and lifecycle TOCTOU races.
priority_harness_fixtures: recovery action must not retrigger itself from own lifecycle telemetry
cancel must reach live execution authority within bounded latency
clean-environment packaged boot with declared dependencies only
interactive/stalled installer step must surface phase and timeout rather than hang
fresh vs upgrade vs restore state boot must preserve hashes/provenance
same acceptance semantics across H1 multi-service, H2 ClayCode and H3 one-module topology
